problems.where: src/simulation/pciBench.ts deploy() (post-dilatation loop, about lines 430-451) and src/ui/bench/OptimisePanel.tsx
problems.problem: Post-dilatation balloons are silently capped at the stent's labelled dilatation limit and nothing is fed back. In the app, a 3.0 x 18 mm stent in focal-lad (limit shown as 3.50 mm) was post-dilated with a 4.00 mm non-compliant balloon at 18 atm (4.19 mm on the chart). The result was score 100, expansion 93%, no events and no tip. Because the perforation check runs after d = min(d, maxD), an oversized balloon can never perforate either. The learner is rewarded for exactly what the stent panel says not to do.
problems.fix: In deploy(), when a post-dilatation balloon's chartDiameter exceeds maxStentDiameter(stent.diameter) within its zone, push an event (for example kind 'stent-overdilated', severity minor, text 'Post-dilatation beyond the stent's labelled dilatation limit') and deduct it in the score. Run the perforation test against the uncapped balloon diameter pd versus the EEM (pd > e * 1.12 outside calcium) as well as the achieved stent diameter. Show 'stent limit X mm' in OptimisePanel beside the pressure readout. Map the new kind in benchTips.ts. Label any new factor MODEL PARAMETER in docs/realism/facts, and add a pciBench.test.ts case (focal-lad, 3.0 stent, 4.0 NC at 18 atm: event raised, score below 100).

problems.where: src/simulation/pci/ivus.ts eemMeasurable() (line 317) as used by src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx (eemSeen)
problems.problem: On IVUS the readout reports EEM area (13.20 mm²) and plaque burden (78%) at the calcified-rca 20 mm frame. The renderer correctly shows a 300° bright arc with an acoustic shadow and no back edge, so the EEM is not visible behind most of the circumference. The module text (src/content/manual/pci-manual/15-imaging.ts line 363) teaches that IVUS shows only calcium's leading edge and a shadow. eemMeasurable() withholds the EEM only for OCT (lipid or penetration), so the numbers contradict the image.
problems.fix: In eemMeasurable(), return false for IVUS when the frame's calcium arc exceeds a threshold. Label the threshold MODEL PARAMETER in docs/realism/facts unless the module text gives one. Alternatively, show the EEM row as 'interpolated behind shadow' in the PciBench readout. Keep pre-PCI sizing on the reference frames, where the EEM is visible, so the sizing guidance is unchanged.

problems.problem: A minor bench event whose own text says 'transient slow flow' or 'slow flow' (lipid predilatation, pciBench.ts lines 343 and 376) also raises the 'no-reflow' lab event. That puts no-reflow management tips (pci-noreflow-hold-contrast, pci-stent-not-into-no-reflow) and pci-calc-rota-slow-flow first in the visible top five, even though no atherectomy was used. pci-principles-explain-unexpected is reachable only further down the list (the test uses tipsFor(ctx, 20)).
problems.fix: Map a 'no-reflow' BenchEvent with severity 'minor' to ['slow-flow'] only, and keep ['no-reflow','slow-flow'] for the major post-dilatation no-reflow (pciBench.ts line 491). This needs benchTipContext to read e.severity. Re-run benchTips.scenario.test.ts; the slow-flow case should still find pci-principles-explain-unexpected.

fix2.notes:
All three in-scope findings were confirmed against the code and fixed. Typecheck and package tests pass.

1. Over-dilating the stent was silently rewarded (major).
- Confirmed: a 3.0 mm stent post-dilated with a 4.0 NC balloon at 18 atm scored 100 with no events.
- Fixed in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/pciBench.ts:
  - There is a new event kind, 'stent-overdilated' (minor). deploy() raises it when a post-dilatation balloon in its zone opens wider than the stent's catalogue dilatation limit. The text gives the balloon diameter and the limit. Minor events already cost 5 points each, so no new score factor was needed.
  - The perforation check now also tests the balloon itself: its diameter as far as the wall lets it open, against EEM x 1.12 outside calcium. The stent profile is still held at the limit.
  - The minor severity is marked MODEL PARAMETER in the code. The limit itself is the catalogue's.
- OptimisePanel.tsx has a new required prop, stentLimitMm. PciBench.tsx passes maxStentDiameter(stent.diameter), and the pressure readout now shows 'stent limit X mm'.
- In benchTips.ts the new kind maps to no tip event, because LAB_EVENTS has nothing for over-dilation.
- Tests added to pciBench.test.ts: the finding's case (event raised, text shows the 3.50 limit, score below the within-limit run); a 3.25 mm balloon gives no event; a 4.5 NC at 20 atm perforates while every stent diameter stays at or under 3.5 mm.

2. IVUS reported EEM area and plaque burden behind a calcium shadow (minor).
- Confirmed against the module text (15-imaging.ts line 363).
- Fixed in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/pci/ivus.ts: there is a new constant, MP_IVUS_EEM_HIDDEN_ARC_DEG = 180, labelled MODEL PARAMETER because the module gives no threshold. eemMeasurable() now returns false on an IVUS frame whose calcium arc exceeds it.
- Pre-PCI sizing is unchanged: it uses preImaging() and the reference frames, which have no calcium.
- ivus.test.ts test added: calcified-rca at 20 mm is not measurable on IVUS; the frames at 0 mm and at the segment end are.

3. Minor slow flow raised the no-reflow tips (minor).
- Fixed in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/lab/benchTips.ts: a new function, benchEventTips(e), maps a minor 'no-reflow' event to ['slow-flow'] only. The major post-dilatation no-reflow still raises ['no-reflow','slow-flow'] and the complication phase.
- benchTips.test.ts test added for both paths. benchTips.scenario.test.ts still finds pci-principles-explain-unexpected.

Out of scope, reported for other packages:
- docs/realism/facts needs entries for MP_IVUS_EEM_HIDDEN_ARC_DEG = 180 and the minor severity of the stent-overdilated event. docs/ is not in this package's file list, so they are labelled in the code only.
- Lipid slow flow no longer raises no-reflow, and pci-noreflow-hold-contrast has left the list. But pci-calc-rota-slow-flow and pci-stent-not-into-no-reflow are still the top two, because their triggers in src/content/lab/tips.ts fire on 'slow-flow' alone. pci-principles-explain-unexpected is now 9th of 20. Fixing the order needs a tips.ts change, for example making the rota tip require 'burr-deceleration'.
- No LabEvent exists for post-dilatation beyond a stent's limit. Adding one in tips.ts would let a tip respond to 'stent-overdilated'; the overexpansion limits are also in pci-bench-stent-platforms-sizing's scope.
- Finding 4 (App.tsx crash on an unknown section id) is listed under rejected for scope only; it still needs fixing.
